run_demo_qinco: run the demo script to reproduce QINCo paper results using Faiss QINCo implementation
review_bvecs_mmap: review the bvecs_mmap function from faiss.contrib.vecs_io for memory-mapped vector loading
review_qinco_encode: review the faiss QINCo encode method for encoding vectors into quantized codes
review_qinco_decode: review the faiss QINCo decode method for decoding quantized codes back to vectors
review_tensor2d: review the faiss Tensor2D wrapper for converting numpy arrays to Faiss tensors
